cohort: Preterm infants with respiratory distress syndrome (RDS) born at 32 weeks of gestation or earlier who received one of three animal-derived surfactant preparations (poractant alfa, calfactant, and beractant) at a single neonatal intensive care unit between 2017 and 2021.
finding: There were no statistically significant differences in respiratory function or other measured outcomes between preterm infants with RDS treated with poractant alfa, beractant, or calfactant.
